_note: Shops by id. Register stock from the-lab/pit-maps/shops-silverton.json (seat-PROPOSED prices); extra stock beyond the register is invented.json#shop-stock.

vilar.name: Show-Armorer
vilar.greeting: Blades that sing on stage or bite in earnest. Repairs, without asking which.
vilar.src: the-lab/pit-maps/shops-silverton.json pin 20 (spear, mace, shield; blunted anything); urtusk-children-prerolls.pdf p.6 (chain mail and shield out of the show-armourer's shop)

kessler.name: The Pawnbroker
kessler.greeting: A third of value on the pledge, interest by the week. No questions that matter.
kessler.src: the-lab/pit-maps/shops-silverton.json pin 8 (unredeemed pledges at half to three-quarters PHB)

calla.name: Apothecary
calla.greeting: Healer's kits, antitoxin, theriac, purges. Honest remedies above the counter.

marko.name: Provisioner
marko.greeting: Rations, rope, tents, mules. Guards by the day: two gold a man.

kasten.name: Chandler
kasten.greeting: Candles, soap, lamp-oil. Mines and arenas both burn a lot of light.

lisbet.name: Charms & Chalk
lisbet.greeting: Warding chalk, five coppers the stick. Charms: no promises made.

tally.name: The Tally-House
tally.greeting: Doses out, weights in. The draught's a silver, taken at the board.

cassia.name: Coaching Inn
cassia.greeting: Eight silver the good bed. A company takes the long room: sixteen, however many of you.
cassia.src: the-lab/pit-maps/shops-silverton.json pin 11 (bed, comfortable, the night 8 sp); party rate RULED 09-24 (Griz: 8 alone, a set 16 for the party)

lucia.name: Mama's Pharmakaiea
lucia.greeting: Mama mixes, I sell. Stitches are Davos. Anything that goes in a mouth is us.
thanks: Mama says take it with food.
For the sand or the road, it works the same.
lucia.src: wiki/the-hex.md (Mama's Pharmakaiea, shop card 'Consult Lucia'); a shop RULED 09-24 (Griz); stock invented.json#mamas

percy.name: Percy's Particulars
percy.greeting: Road harvest rendered, jarred and priced. I pay a fifth of what it sells for once it's rendered. That's the rendering.
percy.nothingText: Nothing on you worth a jar. Bring me parts: silk, hide, fur, glands. Somebody with the hands for it has to take them.
boughtText: Fair. It'll be worth five of that on the shelf.
I don't render what renders me. This, I'll render.
percy.src: wiki/vice-row.md (Percy's Particulars: road harvest rendered, jarred, priced); the-lab/pit-maps/shops-silverton.json pin 38; RULED 09-24 (a fifth of the post-process price; his shelf is flavor)

winters.name: Acquisitions & Estates
winters.greeting: Everything on these shelves outlived somebody. The price is for the somebody.
thanks: Look after it. Its last owner didn't.
Paid in full. I'll write it in the book.
It was a good estate. Mostly.
winters.src: wiki/fountain-street.md (Winters, Acquisitions & Estates); magic stock RULED 09-24 (Griz: he sells magic items); invented.json#winters-shelves

qm.name: Garrison Stores
qm.greeting: Garrison stores. Rope, oil, a healer's kit. Silver is silver, even when nobody assays it any more.
qm.src: handoff-2026-09-26-dragonsleep-dwarven-expansion-spec.md §4.4 (the quartermaster sells rope, lamp-oil, antitoxin, rations, a healer's kit, at garrison prices; buys nothing)

copperbottom.name: The Copperbottom Smith
copperbottom.greeting: Dwarven-made, and nothing magic. Favor is earned, not bought. Mind the anvil.
thanks: Bring it back if it bends. It won't.
Good steel. Better hands, I hope.
copperbottom.src: handoff-2026-09-26-dragonsleep-dwarven-expansion-spec.md §4.5 (the Copperbottom smith: repairs; dwarven-made mundane gear; nothing magic is sold, CANON's shape); splint: better armor than the surface sells (wiki/deepholm-and-the-edifice.md, dwarven favor)
